title: Security patrol sync — private-deploy KMS handoff
content:
Security patrol sync — 2026-09-01
Owner: Asha Patel
Attendees: A. Patel, M. Rivera, L. Cho, O. Haddad, P. Kapoor, + Dana (sre) joined for secrets topic
Location: #sec-sync Slack call / Zoom
Duration: 45m

Agenda:
- Quick triage digest (open vulns since last week)
- Secrets rotation status for private deployments (KMS onboarding)
- Threat-modeling follow-up: Private Control Plane + customer KMS integration
- Action items & owners
- Parking lot / notes to self

Summary / Top-of-call notes:
- Focus this week on two related threads: 1) addressing medium/high vuln backlog from image scanning (container libs) and 2) sequencing customer KMS rollouts so secrets rotation doesn't break Dedicated/Private control plane.
- We decided to gate KMS onboarding for new Private customers until rotation playbook and automated smoke tests land (see SEC-421).

Vuln triage highlights (fresh items):
1) image-scan: alpine-libcrypto (CVEs aggregated) — severity: HIGH (7.8). Affects private-deploy agent images used in on-prem installer.
   - Current status: mitigation in progress (pin to patched base image + rebuild pipeline).
   - Owner: Miguel Rivera. Due: 2026-09-05. Linked: SEC-538.
2) dependency: django-authz third-party (reported via OSS scan) — severity: MEDIUM (5.6). Used in a small admin debug endpoint (internal).
   - Remediation: remove endpoint from public surface and add auth checks; small PR prepared.
   - Owner: Lena Cho. Due: 2026-09-07. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/webapp/pull/780
3) potential secrets exposure: stale env vars in bake artifacts for integration tests — severity: LOW (3.1).
   - Short-term: purge artifacts and rotate any tokens touched.
   - Owner: Omar Haddad. Due: 2026-09-03.

Decisions taken:
- Freeze new customer KMS enablement until the rotation automation & e2e smoke (kms-rotation-smoke) green — blocking decision documented in SEC-421.
- For the alpine-libcrypto issue, we will apply a patched base image and send a canary deploy to two staging clusters before broad roll. If any latency/regression observed, auto-rollback to previous image. (Miguel to coordinate Canary).

Secrets rotation / KMS integration notes:
- Problem: when a customer supplies an external KMS, our private control plane needs to rotate tenant service-account keys and provider secrets without downtime. Risk vector: a partial rotate that leaves one side referencing an old key -> auth failures.
- Proposed flow (agreed in principle):
  1) Create new encrypted secret version in customer KMS (or Redwood-managed fallback).
  2) Stage new secret to secondary agent instances while primary still serves traffic.
  3) Smoke tests verify ability to decrypt (automated test suite + sample request).
  4) Switch over traffic and monitor error-rate -> if > 1% for 5m, rollback.
- Automation gaps: we need an idempotent orchestration step and a pre-check that the KMS IAM binding exists for the control-plane principal.
- Action: Priya to prototype the orchestration step using a state machine (small PoC). Due: 2026-09-10. Jira: SEC-650 (create).

Threat modeling follow-up (Private control plane + customer KMS):
- Attack scenarios reviewed:
  A) Compromised on-prem installer machine with cached secrets -> mitigation: make installer ephemeral, clear caches after install, and enforce the use of ephemeral signing tokens.
  B) Malicious tenant KMS policy that denies Redwood principal mid-rotation -> mitigation: pre-rotation IAM check + fallback to Redwood-managed ephemeral keys and notify customer.
  C) Replay of old encrypted payloads -> mitigation: include rotated-version metadata and require version check on ingestion.
- Outstanding question: do we need HSM-backed attestations for higher-tier customers? Consensus: Yes for enterprise regulated customers; capture as an add-on in pricing. Follow-up: Dana (sre) to scope minimal HSM proof-of-concept. Due: 2026-09-17.

Action items (owner / due / status):
- Miguel Rivera — rebuild & deploy patched base image for private-agent (alpine-libcrypto). Due 2026-09-05. Status: in_progress. Linked SEC-538.
- Lena Cho — land webapp PR to remove debug admin endpoint + add stricter auth checks. Due 2026-09-07. Status: in_review. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/webapp/pull/780
- Omar Haddad — purge old integration artifacts and rotate tokens; produce short runbook for devs. Due 2026-09-03. Status: todo.
- Priya Kapoor — PoC for KMS rotation orchestration (state-machine) + doc for pre-rotation verifier. Due 2026-09-10. Status: todo. Jira SEC-650.
- Dana (sre) — scope HSM attestation PoC for enterprise private customers. Due 2026-09-17. Status: todo.
- Asha Patel — write short communication for Solutions Eng to set customer expectations about KMS rollout freeze; draft to go to #customer-success. Due 2026-09-02. Status: in_progress.

Risks & mitigation backlog (parking lot):
- Risk: Rollouts with mixed agent versions may expose API incompatibilities. Mitigation: add version gate in control plane to block rotation if agent < required version.
- Risk: Secrets management telemetry gaps (we don't have token-level rotate metrics). Mitigation: add minimal metrics during rotation (rotate.success, rotate.fail, rotate.duration).

Notes to self / miscellaneous (informal):
- Remember to sync with Product lead (Jon) about gating KMS as it affects closed-won deals — he asked for a short blurb.
- Keep the emergency rollback checklist near the top of the runbook (token rotation, logs to inspect, how to reissue old key).
- Quick follow-up: schedule 30m dry-run with infra and SRE next Tuesday to execute full rotation on staging. Action: Asha to create calendar invite.

Meeting close: next sync 2026-09-08 (same time). Requested prework: owners to update Jira tickets with estimated hours and brief runbook snippets.

Attachment ideas for final doc: sample smoke-test scripts, sample IAM policy snippet, example rotation-state machine diagram (to add to confluence).

---
Handwritten-ish TODO (notes to self):

- Postmortem template for any rotation-related customer incident (if any) — add to SEC runbooks page.

End of notes.
